scripts.test: npm run test:run -w @landednz/api && npm run test -w @landednz/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @landednz/api && npm run build -w @landednz/web
scripts.docker:api: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t landednz-api . && sed -e 's/127\.0\.0\.1/host.docker.internal/g' -e 's/^PORT=.*/PORT=3000/' -e 's/^NODE_ENV=.*/NODE_ENV=production/' apps/api/.env.local > apps/api/.env.docker && docker run --rm -p 3001:3000 --env-file apps/api/.env.docker landednz-api
